source: Anthropic, Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card (2026-02-17), section 2.18; numbers read from Figure 2.18.2.A (WebArena-Verified) and Table 2.18.1.A (WebArena)
note: Official WebArena-Verified prompt and grader; 'the same scaffolding' as 2.18.1: the Computer Use API with browser tools for screenshot and DOM based navigation, general-purpose system prompt, one policy model. Average of 5 runs per task. All sites of the benchmark (including map and wikipedia), not our single-site sample; a different tool layer and harness from every row we ran, so it is a reference for the model's level, not a tool-layer comparison. Whiskers in the figure are not read here.

rows.subset: original WebArena, 812 tasks, official grader with a Claude fuzzy_match judge
